summary: BBVA filed a Form 6-K to disclose a routine committee reorganization approved by its Board of Directors on April 29, 2026. The filing names the new membership of the Audit, Remuneration, and Risk and Compliance Committees, while noting that the Executive, Appointments and Corporate Governance, and Technology and Cybersecurity Committees remain unchanged. The report is a standard corporate governance update under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, with no transaction, shareholder solicitation, or strategic event. As a non-U.S. filer, this 6-K serves the same function as a U.S. current report for routine board matters. There are no deal terms, strategic actions, or special situations to analyze.
